item.title: Annual mid-winter survey observes 51 eagles in BLM Pinedale region
item.description: PINEDALE, Wyo. — An annual mid-winter eagle count by the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) Pinedale Field Office documented 51 eagles, including bald eagles and golden eagles. The same survey from the BLM Kemmerer Field Office yielded 17 eagles.
